note: Same defect as unterminated_via_unclosed_quoted_key.ktav, but the compound IS the document's first content line (root-kind still undecided). A first line beginning with `{` is routed by Sec 5.0.1 rules 2-5 on bracket-balance, not by the separator-scanning rule rules 6-7 use -- the unterminated `"` swallows the line's only `}`, so the root-level compound never closes and this is UnterminatedInlineCompound, not MalformedInlineCompound (Sec 6.12 requires an already-closed compound) and not UnterminatedQuotedKey (Sec 6.16 excludes inline-pair positions).
